mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the two things that get undercover officers in trouble."
Complacency and greed are the two things that get undercover officers in trouble.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the backbone of policing has been a long-time axiom."
Patrol is the backbone of policing has been a long-time axiom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the most dangerous aspects of a police officer's job."
Traffic stops are one of the most dangerous aspects of a police officer's job.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document filed in court detailing the offences committed by the accused person."
A charge is a document filed in court detailing the offences committed by the accused person.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first and foremost law enforcement agents not only in Nigeria but in other climes, hence they are the closest law enforcement to the public."
The Nigeria police is the first and foremost law enforcement agents not only in Nigeria but in other climes, hence they are the closest law enforcement to the public.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical responsibility of police officers."
Traffic law enforcement is a critical responsibility of police officers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an action involving constant movement within a given area or, in policing, within a given beat."
Patrolling is an action involving constant movement within a given area or, in policing, within a given beat.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the organisational component of a law enforcement agency that typically has the poorest image in the eyes of both law enforcement officers and citizens."
Internal affairs is the organisational component of a law enforcement agency that typically has the poorest image in the eyes of both law enforcement officers and citizens.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an enormous electronic filing cabinet that is capable of storing information and retrieving it in any desired format."
An automated database is an enormous electronic filing cabinet that is capable of storing information and retrieving it in any desired format.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means placing a person under lawful detection against his will for the purpose of law enforcement."
Arrest means placing a person under lawful detection against his will for the purpose of law enforcement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Thursday-they raided yesterday, they will raid tomorrow."
Today is a Thursday-they raided yesterday, they will raid tomorrow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an exercise in symbolic demarking of what is immoral, wrong, and outside the boundaries of acceptable conduct."
Policing is an exercise in symbolic demarking of what is immoral, wrong, and outside the boundaries of acceptable conduct.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tort of strict liability."
Unlawful detention or imprisonment is a tort of strict liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when a suspect matches the description given by a witness and is apprehended close to the crime scene."
Field identification is used when a suspect matches the description given by a witness and is apprehended close to the crime scene.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extremely important form of positive identification."
Fingerprint identification is an extremely important form of positive identification.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the enforcers, the crime fighter/zealot, the social service agent and the watchdog."
Four basic styles of policing are the enforcers, the crime fighter/zealot, the social service agent and the watchdog.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a functional unit and a public relations tool-and it is both in all kinds of weather, as long as it is operated with caution and common sense."
Motorcycle is a functional unit and a public relations tool-and it is both in all kinds of weather, as long as it is operated with caution and common sense.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used extensively on our coasts to apprehend gun and narcotics smugglers as well to curtail sea pirates' activities."
Water patrol is used extensively on our coasts to apprehend gun and narcotics smugglers as well to curtail sea pirates' activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first and foremost law enforcement agents in the criminal justice corridors."
The police is the first and foremost law enforcement agents in the criminal justice corridors.

police organisation

beat

police officer
